**5 \- ZONE DIVISION OF ANDHRA PRADESH**

Andhra Pradesh has **28 districts**. Markapuram and Polavaram are the two districts added after the 2022 reorganisation. Current AP government data lists **688 revenue mandals**.

**A MAP OF 5 ZONES DIVISION OF ANDHRA PRADESH**

**![][image1]**

**DIVISION OF 5 ZONES OF ANDHRA PRADESH**

| Zone |      Name | Districts | Approx. mandals |
| ----- | :---- | ----- | ----- |
| **Zone 1** | **North Coastal & Agency Zone** | Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Parvathipuram Manyam, Alluri Sitharama Raju, Visakhapatnam, Anakapalli | **119** |
| **Zone 2** | **Godavari & Coastal Delta Zone** | Polavaram, Eluru, West Godavari, East Godavari, Kakinada, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema | **122** |
| **Zone 3** | **Krishna–Guntur Central Coastal Zone** | NTR, Krishna, Guntur, Bapatla, Palnadu, Prakasam | **140** |
| **Zone 4** | **South Coastal & Rayalaseema Transition Zone** | SPSR Nellore, Tirupati, Chittoor, Annamayya, Markapuram | **146** |
| **Zone 5** | **Core Rayalaseema Zone** | Ananthapuramu, Sri Sathya Sai, Kurnool, Nandyal, Y.S.R. Kadapa | **161** |
|  | **Total** | **28 districts** | **688** |
